prompts.lettering: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished flat vector-style logo exploration board for TASTIQ, a Russian-language entertainment discovery service for games, films, series and animation: "someone understood my wish and found my option for tonight". Direction A: a proprietary TYPOGRAPHIC identity, NO separate pictogram beside the main name. Main logo text verbatim: "tastiq" in lowercase. Draw custom wide confident contemporary rounded sans lettering, tightly but expertly optically kerned; a memorable open-cut lowercase q with a decisive diagonal tail that can stand alone as the app mark. Strong human editorial character, not tech startup sameness. Exact name legibility is essential, t a s t i q. The q is the identifying detail, do not add a check mark or sparkle. Flat monochrome ink #282a2c on clean warm paper #f5ece2, optional restrained copper #b84025 on the q tail. Landscape sheet with very generous margins: large main wordmark in upper two-thirds; bottom strip shows the standalone q on a copper square and small white-on-graphite wordmark at navigation size. No other text, no captions, no slogan, no numbers. All elements mathematically clean, crisp, isolated, suitable for later vector reconstruction. No photography, gradients, shadows, textures, mock merchandise, controller, film reel, play triangle, food, smiley or generic AI sparkle. Do not combine other concepts; this is custom lettering only. Opaque paper background.
